text:
emma: Thinking aloud  Mini Ops Lab: two 40-min sessions for infra/platform engineers. Keep it super tactical: session 1 = "Cost tactics (quant + cache + batching)", session 2 = "Routing & graceful degradation". Each 30 demo / 10 slides / Q&A. Good landing copy ideas?

mike: Love the format. Suggest simple abstracts we can reuse as social posts. Example: 'Mini Ops Lab: cut inference unit cost with quantization and caching. Live benchmarks + hands-on lab.'

sophia: I can draft the cost abstract + 4-slide benchmark narrative. Will include one chart showing per-token cost delta q8 vs fp16, and a small table on latency vs batch size. ETA Wed.

raj: For routing session, Ill demo policy-based fallbacks and canaries. Need a short runbook with commands, logs URL, and the exact host cue to trigger failover. Can pair with @oliver.

oliver: Ops checklist: reserve a small Dedicated pool for rehearsals (2h), enable anonymized traffic replay, confirm captions on the recording, and pre-seed test tokens. I'll create the infra runbook and a "Failover Cue" snippet.

emma: Run-of-show idea (40m): 0-2m host intro, 2-6m quick customer story, 6-20m demo #1, 20-28m demo #2, 28-35m config & cost takeaways, 35-40m Q&A. Keep demos short and repeatable.

mike: Lab artifact suggestion: small repo with 8 copy-paste commands + docker-compose to reproduce a burst profile and a steady embed job. Provide a one-liner to reset routing. Example CLI snippet to include in README:
```
# run burst profile
redwood-cli gen --model redwood-medium-q8 --tokens 512 --profile burst
# flip policy
redwood-cli routing set --policy fallback-to-small --threshold-ms 120
```

sophia: I'll attach 3 eval prompts and the CSV of bench runs so marketing can make an infographic. Also adding a short note about how batching affects SLA.

raj: Lead routing taxonomy: tag leads by session + interest. Proposed tags: `miniops.session=cost|routing`, `interest=quant|cache|routing|resilience`, `demo_requested=true|false`. Nurture flow: session-specific follow-up + bench write-up.

oliver: I'll add an "ops playbook" section to the runbook with rollback commands, contact list for infra, and the exact host phrase: "Switching to fallback to keep latency within SLA  demo continues."

devrel-bot: calendar: created two placeholders for Mini Ops Lab sessions. Reminders set (48h, 1h).

emma: Great. Action items: emma = landing + promo copy Tue, sophia = bench slides Wed, mike = lab repo Thu, raj+oliver = runbook Mon before rehearsal. I'll draft host script and send invites. :rocket:
